breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The agent adopted T=1.1 from the flawed output section and even changed the time domain to [0, 1.1] to match it. The ground truth resolves this inconsistency by using T=1.0 (consistent with the domain specification t in [0, 1.0]). The agent did the opposite — it propagated and reinforced the error.
